deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds an unsourced link by asserting that the stained slice through a tumour 'illustrates this' (referring to explanting the tumour), whereas the original text presents the slice and stain simply as what is being looked at, not as an illustration of explanting.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].

considerations.sourcePassage: Whoops, I forgot to start my clock. Okay.
considerations.reason: This is a dropped remark to the audience / lecturer filler, which is an allowed omission.

considerations.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture.
considerations.reason: Omitting 'really' in 'do not grow in culture' does not remove a scientific hedge, as 'really' was used colloquially as an intensifier following 'in fact, all of those cells will not grow'.

considerations.sourcePassage: with regard to the contributions of things like the stroma and other things.
considerations.reason: Rendering 'and other things' as 'and other components' is an acceptable stylistic rewording that preserves the original meaning.
